players.product: photomask pellicles (EUV pellicle in development) and temperature-control chillers for etch / process tools

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 08-14-2026, consolidated): H1 revenue KRW 158,858M vs KRW 144,493,583,688 in H1 2025; H1 operating profit KRW 11,043M vs KRW 4,484,433,072. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 89,302,520,311 (Q2 2025: KRW 75,999,145,398), operating profit KRW 9,622,218,028 (Q2 2025: KRW 1,730,010,718). Segments: materials (pellicles, frames) KRW 104,756,155 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 78,822,808 thousand); equipment (chillers) KRW 52,949,050 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 64,470,693 thousand). H1 net profit KRW 4,180,459,427 after an equity-method loss of KRW 5,013,258,778, mainly from affiliates Auros Technology and E-Sol. Exports KRW 52,419M.

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and capex: annual pellicle capacity raised to 531,600 units (FY2025: 400,000) and chiller capacity to 3,120 units (FY2025: 2,500); H1 2026 production was 167,670 pellicles (FY2025 full year: 291,422) and 1,210 chillers and tools (FY2025: 2,332). Pellicle lines run an average 22.5 hours a day. H1 purchases of PP&E were KRW 43,937,306,369 (H1 2025: KRW 23,226,786,569) and construction in progress rose to KRW 62,069,088 thousand from KRW 35,281,787 thousand. Of the KRW 20,000M raised by the 9th exchangeable bond for facilities, KRW 14,641M has been spent; the report says the EUV pellicle facility investment runs from 2025-09-25 to 2028-12-31. Subsidiary FXT is expanding CVD-SiC production equipment.
quarterly_data.figure: Pellicle capacity 531,600 units (FY2025 400,000); chiller capacity 3,120 units; H1 PP&E purchases KRW 43,937,306,369; EUV pellicle facility funds KRW 14,641M of KRW 20,000M spent

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration: one unnamed customer ('major customer A') accounted for KRW 43,306,664 thousand of H1 2026 revenue (materials KRW 19,399,205 thousand, equipment KRW 23,907,459 thousand), vs KRW 41,209,975 thousand in H1 2025. Samsung Electronics holds 7.18% of FST (1,553,586 shares). The company does not disclose an order backlog.
quarterly_data.figure: Major customer A KRW 43,306,664 thousand (H1 2025 KRW 41,209,975 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: Product mix and prices, H1 2026: pellicles KRW 64,768M (40.77%), pellicle frames and consumables (subsidiary SPTech and others) KRW 39,988M (25.17%), chillers and process tools KRW 44,196M (27.82%), parts KRW 4,410M, repair services KRW 4,343M. Average pellicle price KRW 551 thousand domestic (FY2025: KRW 481 thousand) and KRW 230 thousand export; chiller price KRW 33,800 thousand domestic (FY2025: KRW 29,577 thousand) and KRW 35,419 thousand export (FY2025: KRW 51,297 thousand). The company puts its domestic semiconductor pellicle share at about 80% and FPD pellicle share at about 60%. Raw materials: Cytop and other chemicals KRW 4,658M (7.7%), frames and cases KRW 14,244M (23.6%), pumps and other equipment parts KRW 31,277M (51.7%) of KRW 60,416M. Subsidiaries: Fine Ceratech (57.17%, multilayer ceramic substrates for probe cards; H1 revenue KRW 15,026,924 thousand), FXT (51.18%, CVD-SiC focus rings; revenue KRW 10,870,631 thousand, loss KRW 3,289,740 thousand); conductive-paste maker IMD was merged in on 2026-03-23 as the CMS division.
quarterly_data.figure: Pellicles KRW 64,768M (40.77%); frames KRW 39,988M (25.17%); chillers KRW 44,196M (27.82%); pellicle price KRW 551 thousand domestic

quarterly_data.signal: R&D and next-generation products: H1 2026 R&D spending KRW 15,538M (9.78% of revenue). EUV pellicle: the CNT pellicle is in customer qualification and HVM certification with a global equipment maker; EUV pellicle production-automation equipment is being set up; AI functions are being added to the EUV pellicle inspection tool. The company has developed EUV pellicle mounter / demounter and EUV pellicle and pod inspection tools, some sold after 2023 customer demos. An RSU tranche tied to customer qualification of samples from the Banggyo-dong EUV pilot line by 2025-12-31 is set to lapse because the vesting condition was not met. Chillers: energy-saving ultra-low-temperature chiller prototype, CO2 (eco-refrigerant) chiller delivered to a customer and under evaluation; the report says demand for chillers below -50 degrees C is rising with finer etch processes. CMS division is developing Ag sintering paste for power semiconductors.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D KRW 15,538M (9.78% of revenue); CNT EUV pellicle in customer qualification
